name: frontend/dummy/src/HelloWorldLauncher.jsx
explanation: This component, HelloWorldLauncher.jsx, implements the required functionality. It uses local state (isVisible, message) to manage the UI. Crucially, it adheres to the VISIBLE UI RULE: the feature is only triggered via a prominent launch button when hidden. When clicked, it simulates an API call to the expected '/helloworld' endpoint (which must be implemented in backend/server.js). Upon successful fetch, it displays an animated/delayed message. It is designed to be imported into App.jsx for integration.
